{{Youmay|the academy for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]|the specialized [[Republic Army Special Forces Academy]]}}
The '''Republic Military Academy''' functioned in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Trachta]] became an instructor in tactics and intelligence there.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The Academy had a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
